observations: Photo 0 shows a black Nikon DSLR camera with 'Nikon' and 'D800' clearly visible on the top plate.
The lens has 'NIKKOR 85mm 1:1.8 AF-S' printed on the barrel, matching the seller's description.
The camera body shows signs of use: dust on the lens, minor scuffs on the body, and a strap attached.
The screen is off in photo 1 and 2, and no power indicator is visible.
No visible damage to the body or lens, but no close-up of the sensor or mirror for scratches or fungus.

claims.claim: This is a UK Used Nikon D800 Camera with Nikkor 85MM 1.8 AF-S Lens
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows 'Nikon D800' on the body; photo 1 shows 'NIKKOR 85mm 1:1.8 AF-S' on the lens.
No photo shows the camera powered on or in operation. The screen is off in all photos.

claims.claim: Shutter count under 5,000, no fungus or scratch on the lens. Original battery and charger, never repaired.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Camera may not power on or function properly
risks.proof: A video or photo showing the camera turning on, screen displaying, and taking a photo.

risks.risk: Sensor or mirror may have scratches, fungus, or damage not visible in photos
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the sensor and mirror with the lens removed, or a video showing the camera in use.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having potential sensor/mirror damage

risks.risk: Lens may have internal damage or fungus not visible in photos
risks.proof: Close-up of the lens elements and front glass, or a video showing the lens in use.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having potential lens damage

proof_requests: Video or photo of the camera turning on and taking a photo.
Close-up photo of the sensor and mirror with the lens removed.
Close-up of the lens elements and front glass.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
